decisions.reason: Message 22 also changes the basket-weave design, but its existing same-message MODIFY already captures the reduced contrast, added grain and texture, faded finish, softer brown palette, and 5 cm scale without leaving stale attributes.
The source changes the artistic palettes and surface treatments of the two prints, not the CMYK, Pantone, ICC-profile, fabric, or color-calibration workflow.
The feedback explicitly concerns both the Zebra and Weave designs; it does not change the mustard block-color pareo's interior color, border, or included variation count.
